budgets.title: Budget and expiry
budgets.keyHelp: Both this key's limits and its group's shared limits apply.
budgets.groupHelp: All keys in this group share this budget. Individual key limits also apply.
budgets.windowHelp: Rolling spend is released as it ages out. Calendar weeks reset Monday and months on the 1st. Schedule changes start after the current cycle.
budgets.reservedHelp: In-progress amounts are reserved until actual usage is settled. Unconfirmed requests retain reservations. Resetting does not release them or delete bills.
budgets.invalidAmount: Enabled limits must be positive with at most 8 decimal places
budgets.resetHelp: Select periods to clear. The original schedule is preserved by default. Changes are recorded.
budgets.resetNote: Rolling windows and total limits only clear usage. Reservations remain; old requests do not consume the reset budget when settled.
budgets.statsIndependent: Key and group limits both apply; date filters do not change budget windows
budgets.firstActivation: Accounting starts when a monetary limit is first enabled, without charging earlier usage. Disabling limits keeps accounting active; re-enabling does not reset usage.
budgets.manageSeparately: Limits are saved separately; editing basic details does not reset usage.
budgets.afterCreate: After creation, configure five-window limits and expiry in the key details. The selected group limits apply immediately.
